meta.name: Ani-Monsters
meta.description:
Ani-Monsters houses anime's dark side with ghosts, demons, and monsters colliding across multiple series and movies like Death Note, Inuyasha, Ghost in the Shell, Zom 100 and more.

Shows: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed), JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Vampire Knight (English Dubbed), One-Punch Man (English Dubbed), Hakaba Kitaro
Available on: Pluto TV
